entities.summary: Olav Sepp is an Estonian chess player and six-time champion of Estonia. Sepp also has several other top three finishes in the Estonian championship: 2nd in 1997, 3rd in 1998, 2nd in 1999 and 2000, 3rd in 2001, 3rd in 2005, and 2nd in 2006. He has represented Estonia in the Chess Olympiads six times: 1992, 1994, 1996, 2000, 2004, and 2006.
